subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my earlier email about paying per validated apply rather than per click. Appcast's 10th annual benchmark in February 2026 reported US cost-per-application and cost-per-hire rose sharply through 2025 while apply rates held high. US apply rates ended 2024 at 6.1 percent with cost-per-application up 4.8 percent (Appcast 2025), the spread where validation and incrementality decide your real cost per apply. We hold out a control group so the applies you pay for read as incremental, like ZipRecruiter layering paid reach on its seeker traffic. Worth comparing against your source mix?
angle: fresh angle: Feb 2026 Appcast 10th-annual report (CPA/CPH rose sharply) + US apply-rate and CPA benchmark band
register_notes: Stage 2 EN jobs_recruitment CPS: acknowledges second follow-up and references prior email; fresh angle = timely development (Appcast 10th-annual report, Feb 2026, CPA/CPH rose sharply in 2025) plus REAL web-verified benchmark band (US apply rate 6.1% end-2024, CPA +4.8%, Appcast 2025); both source URLs retrieved and support the figures; one named peer from brand_candidates (ZipRecruiter), no brand outside the list, no cross-border giant; MobUpps holdout/incrementality referenced with no figure (no illustrative flag); exactly 1 question mark; no sign-off; positives stated directly, no X-not-Y; no hedge before a number; native US-English register.
